about: What each PiDesignTourUITest picture shows and how the walk reached it. Judges read this beside the picture.

states.01-plan: Fresh launch. The fixed app's home: Plan. The + in the top bar is how anything is added. (No Google account in this run; connecting is offered where it's needed and in Settings.)
states.02-add-sheet: Tapped + (same on iPad). The add sheet: a line to type what to add, then every kind of thing by hand.
states.03-add-typing: Typing 'Lunch with Sam at noon tomorrow' into the add sheet's line, not sent yet.
states.04-meal-draft: Sent 'Make a meal with 2 eggs and 1 banana' in the add sheet. The sheet became 'New meal': Pi's draft in the app's own meal editor, with the words it came from; Discard and Save in the sheet's toolbar (Save is the person's approval).
states.06-meal-saved: Tapped Save. The sheet closed onto the Nutrition page with the meal and an Undo toast.
states.07-event-draft: Sent 'Create Pi UI Lunch tomorrow at 13:00 for 30 minutes': 'New event', Pi's draft in the app's own event editor, Discard and Save in the toolbar. This run has no Google account, so the Calendar row offers Connect Google (sign-in opens over the draft and returns to it); on the person's device their calendars are listed.
states.08-review: Tapped the chart button (top left): Review opens as a sheet on every device, for looking back. Its first row is a line to ask a question.
states.09-answer-nutrition: Asked 'Show my protein this month' in Review. The answer page: the nutrition view.
states.10-answer-search: Asked 'Search Banana for yogurt' in Review. The answer page with results.
states.11-answer-search-detail: Tapped the meal result: its details expand in place.
states.12-working: Asked something the fixture model never finishes: the answer page while Pi works, with Stop.
states.13-notes: The Notes tab of the fixed app.
states.14-review-recent: Back from the search answer to Review: the question asked is listed under the ask line, to reopen its answer.
